_comment: Amendments to the published grid. The institute moves lectures after the CSV
is issued, and the CSV is never reissued — so corrections live here and are
reapplied every time the catalogue is rebuilt.
'move'   changes an existing meeting's day and/or slot.
'add'    inserts a meeting that isn't in the CSV.
Each entry needs 'code', 'section', and a 'from' that matches a meeting
exactly, so a typo fails loudly at build time instead of silently doing
nothing. Keep 'note' and 'since' filled in — a year from now they're the
only record of why a time differs from the official grid.
